meta.overviewDescription: Your prize bonds, wins and upcoming draws, checked automatically. No sign-up.
meta.bondsDescription: Add, import or scan the prize bonds you own.
meta.winsDescription: Every draw your bonds have won, with how to claim.
meta.nearMissesDescription: Bonds of yours that came within one digit of a top prize.

tabs.label: My bonds sections
tabs.newWins: {count, plural, one {# new win} other {# new wins}}

status.offlineBody: Showing the copy saved on this device at {time}. Adding or removing bonds is paused until you are back online.
status.revokedTitle: This wallet is closed on this device
status.revokedBody: It was opened on another device with its sync code, or it was deleted. Your bonds below are a saved copy. Enter your latest sync code to open it here again.
status.unavailableTitle: Your wallet could not be loaded
status.unavailableBody: The service is not reachable right now. Your data is safe; please try again in a moment.

syncCode.title: Save your sync code
syncCode.why: There is no account and no password. This code is the only way to open your wallet on another phone or after clearing your browser.
syncCode.copyFailed: Copy did not work. Please write the code down.
syncCode.qrLabel: QR code that opens this wallet on another device
syncCode.qrHelp: Scan it with your other phone's camera to open this wallet there. Anyone who scans it can see your bonds, so keep screenshots private.
syncCode.tipPrivate: Keep it private: anyone with the code can see and change your bond list.
syncCode.tipNoRecovery: We cannot recover it for you. We only keep a scrambled fingerprint of it.
syncCode.tipRotates: When you use it on another device, a new code is shown there and this one stops working.
syncCode.fileRestore: To open your wallet on another device, enter the code at /my/restore or open this link:
syncCode.fileWarning: Keep this file private. Anyone with the code can open your bond wallet.

legacy.title: {count, plural, one {We found # bond number from the previous version} other {We found # bond numbers from the previous version}}
legacy.body: You checked these on this device before. Add them to your wallet so every new draw is checked for you.
legacy.pickDenomination: {count, plural, one {Denomination for # number without one} other {Denomination for # numbers without one}}
legacy.doneBody: {count, plural, =0 {All of them were already in your wallet.} one {# bond was added to your wallet.} other {# bonds were added to your wallet.}}
legacy.error: They could not be added right now. Please try again.

onboarding.title: Track your prize bonds without signing up
onboarding.lead: Add your bonds once. We check them against every draw in our records now and against every new draw automatically.
onboarding.noAccountBody: No email, phone number or password. Your wallet is created the moment you add a bond.
onboarding.automaticBody: Past wins show up straight away, and you can get a notification when a new draw has your number.
onboarding.privateBody: Only you hold the key. We store your bond numbers, not who you are.

overview.title: My bonds
overview.description: Your bonds are checked against every draw automatically.
overview.newWinsBanner: {count, plural, one {You have # new win!} other {You have # new wins!}}
overview.upcomingEmpty: No scheduled draws are listed yet for the denominations you hold.
overview.unclaimedBody: {count, plural, one {# win worth {amount} is not marked as claimed.} other {# wins worth {amount} are not marked as claimed.}}
overview.claimedLocalNote: Claimed marks are saved on this device only.
overview.evLead: An average over many draws for all your bonds, before tax. It is not a prediction.
overview.evExplain: For each bond, every prize amount is multiplied by its number of winners and divided by 999,999 (the numbers in one series), using the latest published prize table for that denomination. Withholding tax is not deducted.
overview.byYearCaption: Number of wins and prize money per year
overview.nearMissBody: {count, plural, one {# of your bonds came within one digit of a top prize.} other {Your bonds came within one digit of a top prize # times.}}

bonds.title: Manage my bonds
bonds.description: Every bond you saved, with its wins. We check them after every draw.
bonds.addBody: Type, paste or upload your list (photo, PDF, Excel, CSV or text) on the check page. Check it, then press Save.

add.title: Add bonds
add.lead: New bonds are checked against every past draw right away.
add.howLabel: How do you want to add them?

modeHelp.single: Type the six digit number printed on the bond.
modeHelp.range: For a bundle with consecutive numbers, enter the first and the last.
modeHelp.paste: Paste numbers from anywhere. Ranges like 123400-123499 work too.
modeHelp.file: A column of six digit numbers. A Denomination column is used when present.
modeHelp.scan: Take a photo of your bonds or choose a PDF. Numbers are read on your device, then you can correct them.

add.label: Label (optional)
add.labelHint: For example whose bond it is
add.rangeHint: Up to {max} bonds at a time
add.rangeInvalid: Enter two six digit numbers, the second not smaller than the first.
add.singleInvalid: A bond number has exactly six digits.
add.pasteHint: Separated by spaces, commas or new lines
add.fileHint: CSV, TXT or Excel (.xlsx, .xls). One file can hold every denomination, and a cell like 100100-100150 adds a whole series.
add.fileRead: {name}: {count, plural, one {# bond found} other {# bonds found}}
add.fileEmpty: No six digit bond numbers were found in that file.
add.fileTooLarge: That file is too large. Please choose one under 15 MB.
add.fileUnreadable: That file could not be read. Try saving it as CSV.
add.invalidRows: {count, plural, one {# row without a valid number} other {# rows without a valid number}}
add.scan: Photo or PDF of your bonds
add.scanHint: Good light and a flat page give the best results
add.scanFailed: We could not read that image. Try a clearer photo, or type the numbers instead.
add.scanReviewHint: Fix any number the scan got wrong before adding.
add.summary: {count, plural, one {# bond ready to add} other {# bonds ready to add}}
add.summaryOwned: {count, plural, one {# already in your wallet} other {# already in your wallet}}
add.summaryInvalid: {count, plural, one {# not valid ({examples})} other {# not valid ({examples})}}
add.nothingToAdd: There are no valid bond numbers to add yet.
add.submit: {count, plural, =0 {Add bonds} one {Add # bond} other {Add # bonds}}
add.readOnly: Adding bonds is paused while your wallet is offline or closed on this device.
add.addedTitle: {count, plural, =0 {No new bonds added} one {# bond added} other {# bonds added}}
add.addedSkipped: {count, plural, one {# was already in your wallet.} other {# were already in your wallet.}}
add.addedWins: {count, plural, one {Good news: # past win found!} other {Good news: # past wins found!}}
add.addedNoWins: No past wins for these bonds. We will keep checking every new draw.
add.addedCreated: Your wallet is ready. Please save your sync code above.

list.title: {count, plural, one {Your # bond} other {Your # bonds}}
list.emptyBody: Add your first bond above. It takes a few seconds.
list.caption: Your bonds, showing {shown} of {total}
list.label: Label

wins.title: My wins
wins.description: Every draw in our records where one of your bonds won.
wins.emptyBody: Add your bonds and we will check them against every draw.
wins.emptyBodyWithBonds: None of your bonds has won in the draws we have. Every new draw is checked automatically.
wins.caption: Your winning bonds, newest draw first
wins.claimedNote: Claimed marks are a personal checklist saved on this device only.
wins.how1: Keep the original bond safe. The prize is paid only against the original.
wins.how2: Fill in the prize claim form at a State Bank of Pakistan (SBP BSC) office or an authorised bank branch, with a copy of your CNIC.
wins.how3: The prize is paid after withholding tax is deducted.
wins.howNote: Check the claim period and current tax rates with National Savings or your bank. BondCheck is an independent service and is not part of the Government of Pakistan.

nearMisses.title: Near misses
nearMisses.description: Your bonds that were one digit away from a 1st or 2nd prize number, or shared its last five digits.
nearMisses.disclaimer: A near miss does not win anything; only an exact match does.
nearMisses.emptyBody: Add your bonds to see how close they came.
nearMisses.emptyBodyWithBonds: None of your bonds came within one digit of a 1st or 2nd prize.
nearMisses.reasonLastFive: Same last five digits, only the first digit was different.

restore.pageDescription: Use the sync code you saved to open your bond wallet on this device.
restore.title: Open a wallet with a sync code
restore.lead: Enter the 12 character code you saved. Your bonds and wins appear here, and a new code is issued for safety.
restore.label: Sync code
restore.hint: Letters and numbers, for example ABCD-EFGH-JKMN. Spaces and dashes are fine.
restore.invalidFormat: A sync code has 12 letters and numbers. Please check it.
restore.notFound: No wallet matches this code. It may be an older code that was replaced when the wallet was opened elsewhere.
restore.rateLimited: Too many attempts. For your security, please try again in {minutes} minutes.
restore.switchWarning: This device already has a wallet with bonds. Opening another one replaces it here. That wallet stays saved, but you will need its sync code to open it again.
restore.switchConfirm: I have the sync code of my current wallet
restore.confirmSwitchRequired: Please confirm that you have saved the sync code of the wallet on this device.
restore.security: For your safety, only 5 attempts per hour are allowed, and the code you use is replaced by a new one.

settings.title: Wallet settings
settings.description: Your sync code, notifications, exports and deletion.
settings.syncBody: Your code was shown when the wallet was created. We cannot show it again because we only store a scrambled fingerprint of it. If you lost it, get a new one now.
settings.syncConfirmBody: Your old sync code will stop working immediately. Devices where this wallet is already open are not affected.
settings.pushBody: Get a notification on this device when a new draw has one of your numbers. Turn it on separately on each device.
settings.pushOnDone: Notifications are on for this device.
settings.pushOffDone: Notifications are off for this device.

pushState.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. Wins still appear here.
pushState.unconfigured: Notifications are not available yet. Wins still appear here.
pushState.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings for this site.

pushError.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
pushError.denied: Permission was not given. You can allow notifications for this site in your browser settings.
pushError.failed: Notifications could not be turned on. Please try again.

settings.exportBody: Download your bonds and wins to keep a record or print.
settings.exportPdfNote: The PDF is in English; the Excel file follows your language.
settings.exportFailed: The export could not be created. Please try again.
settings.privacyStored: Your bond numbers and labels, your wins, a scrambled fingerprint of your key and sync code, and your notification address if you turn notifications on.
settings.privacyNotStored: No name, phone number, email, location or device fingerprint. Rate limits use a scrambled form of your network address, kept for at most a day.
settings.privacyDevice: A copy of your wallet is saved on this device so it opens instantly and works offline.
settings.deleteBody: Permanently erase your bonds, wins, notification settings and sync code from our servers and this device.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. Your sync code will stop working on every device.
settings.deleteCheckbox: I understand that my wallet will be erased

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.conflict: Your wallet has reached its limit for this action.
errors.bad_request: Some of the details are not valid. Please check and try again.
errors.unauthorized: This wallet is no longer open on this device.
errors.unavailable: The wallet service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again soon.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

push.title: Prize bond win
push.singleBody: Your bond {number} (Rs {denomination}) won Rs {amount} in the draw of {date}.
push.manyBody: {count} of your bonds won in recent draws, Rs {amount} in total.
